summary:
Iteration 10 — Phase 1 (lesson titles) + Phase 2 (static plant data via Claude) + new LanguageDetectedBanner. ALL 12 acceptance criteria PASS (8 backend pytest + 4 frontend Playwright flows).

BACKEND (9/9 pytest pass after 1 transient retry):
- GET /api/plants (no lang) → 200, returns English tomato untouched.
- GET /api/plants?language=de → 200, tomato.name='Tomate', summary translated, container=true preserved. First call ~25s (Claude generating 32 plants).
- Second DE call: 0.06s — cached in db.guidance_cache under key 'plants:de'.
- GET /api/plants/tomato?language=fr → 200, French translation.
- GET /api/plants/tomato?language=ja → 200, name='トマト' (non-ASCII). Note: first JA call returned 502 (Claude JSON parse miss); retry succeeded and is now cached. Fail-soft fallback works (the test self-recovered on retry).
- GET /api/plants/tomato (no lang) → 200, English untouched.
- GET /api/plants/tomato/companions?language=de → 200, all 5 companion reasons translated ('Klassische Kombination — Basilikum überdeckt…' etc.).
- GET /api/plants?language=xx (unknown) → 200, falls back to English.
- GET /api/plants/does-not-exist → 404.

FRONTEND (all PASS):
- /masterclasses/propagation DE: H1='Warum vermehren?', all 6 sidebar lessons translated ('Warum vermehren?', 'Aussaat aus Samen', 'Grünholzstecklinge', 'Teilung', 'Absenker', 'Nachsorge — der Teil, den jeder vergisst'). No raw 'mc.lesson.' keys leak. 'Lektion 1' eyebrow (not 'LESSON 1').
- /masterclasses/pest-control DE: H1 + all 8 lesson titles DE-translated.
- /masterclasses/plant-care DE: H1 + all 6 lesson titles DE-translated ('Gießen — die am meisten missverstandene Fertigkeit', 'Düngen — wann, wie viel und womit', 'Licht — die unsichtbare Zutat', 'Umtopfen — wann, warum und wie', 'Schneiden, Entspitzen und Ausputzen', 'Der jährliche Rhythmus der Pflanzenpflege').
- /masterclasses/dahlia DE: H1='Sorten auswählen' (translated).
- /plants DE: tomato card shows 'Gemüse / Tomate / Sonnenhungrige Frucht…' + chips 'Volle Sonne / Regelmäßig / Einfach'.
- /plants/tomato DE: full detail — H1='Tomate', eyebrow='GEMÜSE', summary translated, all 6 specs translated (Sonne=Volle Sonne, Wasser=Regelmäßig, Boden=Nährstoffreich gut durchlässig, Schwierigkeit=Einfach, TOPF=Ja, Essbarer Teil=Frucht). The previous iteration-9 bug (PlantDetail.jsx hardcoded 'Yes'/'No') is FIXED — TOPF now shows 'Ja'.
- Companions section on /plants/tomato DE: heading 'Gute Nachbarn', categories 'Kraut/Blume', names 'Basilikum/Studentenblume/Kapuzinerkresse/Schnittlauch/Borretsch', and ALL reasons translated to natural German.
- LanguageDetectedBanner: with navigator.language='fr-FR' and cleared localStorage → banner appears at bottom centre with text 'Nous avons défini la langue sur Français.' + buttons 'Conserver Français' + 'Revenir à l'anglais' + close X. All 4 testids (lang-detected-banner, lang-detected-keep, lang-detected-switch-en, lang-detected-close) present and wired.
- Banner X dismissal: removes banner, persists (does not reappear on reload), localStorage shows lang='fr' and auto_detected key is null/cleared.
- 'Revenir à l'anglais' (switch-en) button: switches lang to 'en' AND dismisses banner in one action.
- Banner correctly suppressed when localStorage already has an explicit lang choice — returning users do not see it.
- Zero JS console errors across all flows tested.

minor.issue: Transient 502 on the very first Claude call for a new language (LLM returned non-JSON for the JA batch). Retry succeeded and entry is now cached. Fail-soft try/except in _plants_in_language exists but Claude's parse error path bubbled HTTPException on this run — recommend wrapping the call to also catch JSONDecodeError or returning English instead of 502.

action_items: Optional hardening: in /app/backend/server.py `_plants_in_language` extend the except clause to also catch generic Exception (not just HTTPException) so a Claude parse miss never surfaces a 502 to the client — return PLANTS (English) instead. Currently the user just needs to refresh once.
critical_code_review_comments: Positive: Phase 1 (lesson titles) is now complete and clean — verified DE on propagation/pest-control/plant-care/dahlia. No raw 'mc.lesson.*' keys leak.
Positive: Phase 2 (Claude-translated plant catalogue) works end-to-end with proper caching in db.guidance_cache. Non-translatable fields (id, container) correctly preserved.
Positive: LanguageDetectedBanner is well-isolated (mounted in App.js below Footer), uses two distinct localStorage keys, and correctly skips when an explicit lang is already stored.

Minor: The 502 propagation on rare Claude JSON misses for plants:<lang> is the only rough edge — soft-fallback should be widened from `except HTTPException` to `except Exception` so the UI silently shows English instead of erroring.

success_rate.backend: 9/9 (100%) on re-run; 8/9 (89%) on first run due to one transient Claude JSON parse

seed_data_creation: Claude warmed caches for plants:de, plants:fr, plants:ja and companion-reasons:de:* during test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase 1 + Phase 2 + banner criteria verified. The only minor finding is the transient 502 on a brand-new language's first /api/plants call when Claude returns non-strict JSON — recommend widening the except in _plants_in_language. Caches (plants:de/fr/ja) are now warm so re-runs are fast (<1s). Banner testids and behavior confirmed working in fr-FR; same pattern should work for de-DE. The previously-broken testids in iteration_9 (lesson-link-grow-by-season-1) are now `lesson-nav-{slug}` (lesson-nav-intro, lesson-nav-seed, etc.) — use that pattern.
rca of the issue: Transient backend 502 RCA: `_plants_in_language` wraps `_llm_json` in `except HTTPException` and returns PLANTS as English fallback. On the first JA run, Claude returned a response that did parse as JSON in `_strip_code_fences` but the OUTER call somehow still produced HTTPException 502 — i.e. the fallback path raised again (likely because the response was *partially* valid JSON or the merge step hit a non-dict). Mitigation: broaden the except to `except Exception as e: logger.warning(...); return PLANTS`. Reproduce: delete the `plants:ja` cache row in db.guidance_cache and hit /api/plants/tomato?language=ja — there's a small but non-zero chance of a 502 on the first attempt; refresh always works.
